I've been shipping software for 20+ years, from serverless platforms and data pipelines to a native screen recorder and AI agents that run inside real operations. Most recently I led the team at Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión) that put AI document intelligence and an internal LLM agent into a business moving 5,000+ loads a day. Before that I was CTO at Prixz. These days I build with MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, computer-use and voice agents, Rust and Tauri.

FRAME 001product · shipping
nullcolor.app

Nullcolor

Native macOS and Windows app that records screen and webcam together, with a built-in editor, 4K/60 MP4 export and a searchable recording library. Free for individuals, $99 commercial licence.

  • native desktop

FRAME 013open source · shipping
github.com/onevarez/kineto-engine

Kineto

The composition engine inside Nullcolor, open-sourced. A cross-platform Rust binary that gives a screen recording a cinematic treatment (background, padding, rounded corners, shadow, eased auto-zoom) on static FFmpeg, libx264 and libx265.

  • Rust
  • FFmpeg
  • libx264
  • libx265

In production

Systems I've built or led inside companies, running on real traffic.

01

Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión)

Tech Lead Manager

Freight marketplace and execution platform inside one of Mexico's largest logistics groups, running 5,000+ movements a day.

  • Mobile proof-of-delivery capture with OCR and AI contextual extraction, feeding invoicing, reconciliation and payment follow-up.
  • Per-document model routing for varied POD and evidence layouts.
  • Multimedia evidence system that interprets audio, video and images with AI and feeds downstream systems.
  • Internal AI agent across datasets and APIs, used from Slack.
  • Multi-tenant analytics on Athena and Metabase.
02

Prixz

CTO

Mexico's first native online pharmacy: dark-store fulfilment, own site and app, plus Amazon and Mercado Libre storefronts.

  • Led engineering through the move from last-mile delivery provider to digital pharmacy.
  • Owned architecture, platform and hiring.
